title: fake-runner's wallwip mode still gates on the run-wide attempt number
description:
wallwip in internal/reconcile/testdata/fake-runner.sh keys on TICFAC_ATTEMPT = 1 (and on tick a1) - the same latent order-dependence vw0 fixed in the blocked-first and finding_blocked modes, left out of that tick's named scope.

This is the bug class the dispatch window made real: attempt numbers are run-wide, so a fixture mode keyed on 'attempt 1' silently means 'the run's first dispatch', not 'this tick's first try'. Dispatch another tick first and the mode never fires. TICFAC_TRY now exists and the fixture always passes it, so the repair is a one-line gate change plus a test that dispatches another tick before the one under test.

discovered_from run-epic-9pd/tick-vw0/attempt-30
acceptance_criteria: wallwip fires on the tick's own first TRY regardless of how many dispatches the run made before it, and a test proves it by dispatching another tick first. No fixture mode keys on TICFAC_ATTEMPT to mean 'first try'.
